note: OSV lists no fix commit; the 4.1.136 jar diff bundles many codec fixes, so the sinks come from the advisory. The V07 and V08 handshakers accept the upgrade without Connection and Upgrade headers in newHandshakeResponse, present in 4.1.0, 4.1.131 and 4.2.15. WebSocketServerHandshakerFactory picks a handshaker from the client's version header and can build any of them, so any Netty WebSocket server reaches these.
